Clinical Overview

Understanding Sports Medicine

Sports and physical activity can place significant stress on your muscles, joints, ligaments, and tendons. Injuries can affect anyone, from professional athletes to people who enjoy running, gym workouts, or recreational sports.

At Sanadi Orthopaedic Hospital, our sports medicine team provides assessment and treatment for a wide range of sports-related injuries. Depending on your condition, care may include physiotherapy, rehabilitation, injections, or surgery when required.

Our focus is to help you recover safely, restore strength and movement, and return to your sport or daily activities with confidence.

Symptom Evaluation

When athletic performance is compromised

Sports injuries can affect your performance, movement, and everyday activities. Consider an evaluation if you experience:

01

Knee Ligament Injuries

Sudden knee pain, swelling, instability, or a popping sensation after twisting, jumping, or changing direction.

02

Recurrent Ankle Sprains

Repeated ankle injuries, swelling, or a feeling that your ankle is unstable while walking, running, or playing sports.

03

Persistent Tendon Pain

Ongoing pain around the heel, knee, elbow, or other tendons that gets worse during running, jumping, or exercise.

04

Shoulder Pain During Activity

Pain or weakness when throwing, swimming, lifting, serving, or reaching overhead.

05

Muscle Strains & Tears

Sudden pain or tightness in the hamstring, calf, groin, or other muscles during exercise or sports.

Clinical Expertise

Comprehensive Sports Injury Care

Personalised treatment and rehabilitation for sports injuries, helping you safely return to activity.

1 / ATHLETIC LIGAMENT CARE

ACL, PCL & Other Ligament Treatment

Evaluation and treatment for knee ligament injuries, with surgery considered when required to restore stability and function.

  • Ligament Injury Assessment

  • Structured Rehabilitation
2 / BIOLOGICAL INJECTIONS

Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Therapy

PRP treatment may be considered for selected tendon and soft-tissue conditions as part of a personalised treatment plan.

  • Ultrasound-Guided Injections When Recommended
  • Treatment for Selected Tendon Conditions
  • Non-Surgical Treatment Options
3 / RETURN-TO-ACTIVITY CARE

Sports Rehabilitation & Performance

Structured rehabilitation to rebuild strength, balance, movement, and sport-specific function before returning to activity.

  • Strength & Movement Assessment
  • Sport-Specific Exercise & Conditioning
  • Gradual Return-to-Activity Planning
Athletic Protocol

Your Sports Injury Recovery Pathway

A structured approach to help you move from injury through treatment and rehabilitation.

01

Injury Assessment

Your symptoms, movement, strength, and joint stability are assessed to understand the injury.

02

Diagnosis & Imaging

Appropriate imaging and diagnostic tests are recommended to determine the extent of the injury.

03

Personalised Treatment

Your doctor explains the available options, which may include rehabilitation, injections, or surgery when required.

04

Strength & Conditioning

Progressive exercises help rebuild strength, balance, flexibility, and movement.

05

Return to Activity

Your recovery and physical readiness are assessed before gradually returning to sports or other activities.

Match Readiness Focus

Helping You Return to the Activities You Enjoy

Recovery is about more than treating the injury. Our goal is to help you rebuild strength, movement, and confidence so you can safely return to your sport and active lifestyle.
